_about: F-20 Commander Decision Checklist. Declarative: questions + rules. A rule fires when every condition in `when` matches the answers. Verdict = avoid if any avoid rule fires; else wait if any wait rule fires or a required question is unanswered; else go. All advice is strategy (T3/T4), so confidence is medium at best; `split: true` marks divided or single-source community views.

questions.text: What are you about to spend?

options.label: This commander's own sculptures (e.g. Expedition medals, event)

questions.text: What job will this commander do?

options.label: Open-field fighting in my main march

questions.text: Is your main march (primary + secondary) complete, or is this commander part of it?

options.label: This commander is part of my main march
My main march is already complete
My main march is not complete and this is a different commander

questions.text: Does it fill a troop type or role your account does not cover yet?

options.label: No, I already have a commander for this

questions.text: Do you have a pair (primary/secondary) for it?

options.label: A free pair is reachable (e.g. Aethelflaed via Expedition)

questions.text: How long will it stay useful (by season)?

options.label: Past KvK1 / into SoC (consensus long-term pick)
Strong early / KvK1, loses value later

questions.text: How can a F2P get its sculptures?

options.label: Free route (Expedition store, starting commander, VIP 10+ chest)
Mostly Wheel of Fortune / paid offers

questions.text: If this turns out wrong, can a Legendary Commander Swap move the investment?

options.label: Yes, it is a swappable legendary
No (epic, or excluded like the Season 2 commanders)

questions.text: Is a free or cheaper route coming soon (e.g. Legendary Pelagius event from day 5, More Than Gems)?

rules.text: Never spend universal gold sculptures on gatherers or PvE-only commanders; bank them for one long-term legendary.
Finish one complete march first; partially built commanders give little value.
It does not clearly fill a missing role: spreading sculptures over overlapping commanders is the common F2P regret.
No pair yet. Suggested F2P KvK1 pairs differ between sources (Sun Tzu + Aethelflaed, Aethelflaed + Baibars, YSG + flexible).
Gold sculptures on a KvK1-only legendary (Richard I, Charles Martel, Cao Cao, Minamoto): community is divided; they lose value from SoC.
Shelf-life unknown. Tier lists disagree mostly about time horizon; check a dated 2026 list first.
Flagged 'no priority' for F2P in one 2026 tier list (single source).
Rally/garrison leads are usually spender roles; one source says F2P should favour open-field AoE commanders.
A free or cheaper route is coming (e.g. Legendary Pelagius from kingdom day 5; buy VIP/sculptures during More Than Gems).
Short shelf-life and no swap option: the investment cannot be moved later (Season 2 commanders are excluded from the swap).
Mostly Wheel/paid: F2P consensus is 10 Wheel spins on a planned target only after VIP 10; Wheel gem math is outdated where Spin Tickets apply.
Open-field commander for your main march: the investment F2P guides favour.
Long-term pick (YSG is the most cited F2P legendary target).
Sculptures come from a free route (Expedition store: 1,500 medals per legendary sculpture; VIP 10+ daily chest).
No gold sculptures at risk (e.g. Sun Tzu, the safest early F2P investment).
You have, or can get for free, a pair for it.
Legendary Commander Swap (around the end of Season 2, once per character) can move levels/skills/stars later: lowers regret, not a reason by itself.
Gold sculptures are scarce for F2P: bank them for one long-term legendary; free channels are alliance gift chests, VIP 10+ chest, Expedition medals.
